goal: Let a merged low-risk migration promote to production on exact-head ephemeral database CI evidence instead of a shared-preview apply, keeping preview mandatory for high-risk SQL.
prohibited_actions: Do not apply any migration or run any production or preview database write.
Do not relax exact target proof, the production lane lock, review evidence, or post-apply verification.
Do not let the ephemeral route promote SQL the classifier cannot positively recognise as low-risk.
assumptions: The required ephemeral database contract-test job applies every migration and records which applied, so its exact-head success is evidence the merged bytes apply cleanly.
stop_conditions: Stop if the change requires a database write.
Stop if skipping preview would require weakening any production guard other than the preview-evidence input.
